description: Catalog of Resistance Element forms: mathematical laws, dials, and when each form is useful for scaling or soft filtering in non-physical / risk models.

forms.name: Linear resistance
forms.filter_role: Proportional drop; with Capacitance forms a first-order low-pass on effort under flow drive.
selection_hints: Prefer when state-space / matrix exponential evaluation is required

forms.name: Orifice (quadratic)
forms.equation: f = Cd * A * sign(e) * sqrt(2 * abs(e) / rho)
forms.filter_role: Amplitude-dependent gate: weak drives pass little flow; large spikes open. Soft high-pass on amplitude, not on frequency alone.
selection_hints: Need stronger response only after material pressure builds

forms.name: Check (one-way)
forms.equation: f = max(0, f_core(e)) where f_core is linear or orifice
forms.filter_role: Rectifier: blocks reverse flow; locks escalation or habit in one direction.
selection_hints: Prevent backflow into a recovered state

forms.name: Deadzone (threshold)
forms.equation: f = 0 if abs(e) < e0 else f_core(e - sign(e)*e0) or f_core(e)
forms.filter_role: Ignores sub-threshold noise; passes only peaks over threshold.
selection_hints: Suppress chatter below an SLO margin
Combine with Capacitance so only sustained pressure crosses e0

forms.name: Saturation (rate limit)
forms.filter_role: Hard ceiling on throughput; compressive response at high drive.
selection_hints: Queue drain or ticket rate caps
Prevent unbounded linear response under extreme effort

forms.name: Power-law resistance
forms.filter_role: Tunable sensitivity: alpha<1 compressive (like orifice family), alpha>1 expansive.
selection_hints: Need a continuous family between linear (alpha=1) and orifice-like
